changelogEntry: 1.4.1 - Rebuilds Paradee with the deterministic binary64 weight-normalization fold from elizaOS/llama.cpp#91. The source weights and model shapes are unchanged; normalized F32 values receive one final rounding. The updated checksum also records the current converter source. Existing 1.4.0 artifacts must be restaged. 1.4.0 - Paradee-8M v1.2 replaces v1.1 as the TTS: paradee-8m-v1_2.gguf, converted with elizaOS/llama.cpp tools/paradee/convert_paradee_pt_to_gguf.py --version 1.2 (byte-reproducible; elizaOS/llama.cpp#88). v1.2 is v1.1 retrained with four voices in a style table (af_heart, bf_isabella, am_puck, bm_fable); libelizainference speaks af_heart by default and refuses the British voices, which need a British misaki lexicon that is not shipped. The row id changes, so a device that staged tts/paradee/ with v1.1 re-stages it. The eSpeak NG data gains the Spanish (Spain) dictionary (es_dict, lang/roa/es), which the Castilian Spanish Delibes-8M-esES voice of the APK bundle uses (elizaOS/llama.cpp#89, libelizainference ABI 20 voice slots); this catalog does not download Delibes yet. The misaki, Phonon-2 and VAD rows are unchanged from 1.3.0. Paradee v1.2 is converted on the build host from sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.2@ed2934d4df8a4fd891e29584c5e1104649409765 and is not re-uploaded to elizaos/eliza-1; hfRevision pins the elizaos/eliza-1 commit that holds the Silero VAD row. packages/scripts/verify-voice-product-release.ts is the release gate.

changelogEntry: 1.3.0 - Paradee-8M v1.1 replaces v1.0 as the TTS: paradee-8m-v1_1.gguf, converted with elizaOS/llama.cpp tools/paradee/convert_paradee_pt_to_gguf.py --version 1.1 (byte-reproducible). v1.1 keeps v1.0's text side and replaces the iSTFTNet generator with a frame-rate source-filter head (seeded noise, deterministic output); libelizainference routes on the GGUF's paradee.decoder.head key, so a v1.0 file still loads. On a Lenovo TB336FU it runs about 3x faster than v1.0 with about 70 MB peak private memory instead of 202 MB and the same WER (elizaOS/llama.cpp#86). The row id changes, so a device that staged tts/paradee/ with v1.0 re-stages it. The misaki, eSpeak NG, Phonon-2 and VAD rows are unchanged from 1.2.0. Phonon-2 ASR and Paradee v1.1 TTS are the only product voice stack: both are converted on the build host from their pinned Hugging Face sources (FermionResearch/Phonon-2@7e153e4054c0a10db6d47d6fff5c062d4c77c154, sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.1@330617ad1f097b4f6b02c103e54b39006c090b45) and are not re-uploaded to elizaos/eliza-1; hfRevision pins the elizaos/eliza-1 commit that holds the Silero VAD row. packages/scripts/verify-voice-product-release.ts is the release gate.

changelogEntry: 1.2.0 - Qwen3-ASR-0.6B is removed as a speech-recognition option: the text GGUF and mmproj rows are gone and ELIZA_ASR_BACKEND=qwen3 no longer stages them. Phonon-2 (Parakeet-TDT 0.6B, five-value) is the only local ASR: asr/phonon-2-fv5.gguf on libelizainference's parakeet backend (batch + streaming). A device that staged asr/ with the Qwen3-ASR pair re-stages it with Phonon-2. Phonon-2 weights are CC-BY-4.0: ship the attribution and NOTICE. The GGUF is unpublished; build it with packages/app/scripts/voice/build-phonon2-gguf.ts, which converts the pinned FermionResearch/Phonon-2 revision and checks every sha256. Paradee-8M stays the TTS; the Paradee, misaki and eSpeak NG rows are unchanged from 1.1.0.
